name: Bjorn Stromberg
bio:
Bjorn's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Fresh out of university with a degree in marketing, he landed a temporary role assisting with a local rally event. The roar of the engines and the passion of the fans instantly captivated him. He transitioned to karting, and climbed the ladder, now working at Birel ART Factory.

Bjorn's approach to marketing is deeply rooted in understanding the technical aspects of the sport. He believes that authentic marketing stems from a true appreciation of the engineering and skill involved. His focus is on creating engaging content that showcases the team's expertise and the thrill of racing, fostering a strong connection with fans and sponsors. 

What sets Bjorn apart is his ability to blend traditional marketing techniques with innovative strategies. He is constantly exploring new platforms and technologies to reach a wider audience, and he's known for his creative campaigns that capture the essence of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Bjorn is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Frequently uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversations.
Insists on listening to Swedish heavy metal while brainstorming.
